slopium.frame_generation.unavailable: Slopium: frame generation disabled: %s. Normal rendering continues. Apply settings to retry.
slopium.frame_generation_mode.tooltip: Generation is independent of optimizations. Simple reprojects/predicts; FSR interpolates with delay. Real frames immediately uses Slopium prediction. No shader packs or Fabulous.
slopium.frame_generation_target.tooltip: Total output cap. 0 uses only Minecraft and VSync limits.
slopium.frame_generation_cell.tooltip: Motion-cell size in pixels. Smaller preserves detail at higher GPU/VRAM cost. 1 does not guarantee accuracy.
slopium.frame_generation_search.tooltip: Motion search radius in pixels. Larger tracks faster motion but costs more and risks false matches.
slopium.frame_generation_rejection.toolt: Motion error tolerance in pixels. Lower reduces distortion but leaves more unsmoothed regions.
slopium.frame_generation_fsr_debug.toolt: Native FSR diagnostic images. Keep off for play; unused in prediction mode.
slopium.enabled.tooltip: Enable optimizations. Frame generation has its own switch.
slopium.diagnostics.tooltip: /slopium status shows statistics; /slopium reset clears them. Excludes menus and pauses.
slopium.indexed_lighting.tooltip: Search nearby light sources only. Preserves radius and brightness.
slopium.light_cache.tooltip: Reuse lighting results until sources change.
slopium.create_light.tooltip: Create Dynamic Light sources, including its Sable lights.
slopium.sable_light.tooltip: Lights on moving Sable structures. Requires a compatible addon.
slopium.cull_breaking: Skip breaking cracks outside the view
slopium.cull_breaking.tooltip: Skip block-breaking cracks outside the camera. Excludes Sable.
slopium.hidden_ticks.tooltip: Throttle selected blocks hidden by EntityCulling. Server unchanged; client effects may slow.
slopium.tick_interval: Behind obstacles: one tick out of N
slopium.tick_interval.tooltip: One client tick in N behind obstacles. 4 means about 5 updates/s. Server unchanged.
slopium.protected_distance.tooltip: Full-rate radius in blocks. EntityCulling mode only.
slopium.hidden_grace.tooltip: Delay before throttling. 20 ticks ≈ 1 s; visibility and new data reset it.
slopium.disable_be_render.tooltip: Hide special block models. Static geometry and Flywheel remain.
slopium.disable_flywheel_render.tooltip: Hide selected blocks’ Flywheel instances. Static geometry remains.
slopium.disable_particles.tooltip: Hide standard particles and reject new ones. Custom mod systems may remain.
slopium.disable_ambient.tooltip: Disable ambient block/fluid particles and some sounds. Server unchanged.
slopium.freeze_create_ticks.tooltip: Freeze selected blocks’ client ticks. Effects and interactions may stall; server keeps running. Turn off to restore.
slopium.item_lod.tooltip: One model per distant item stack. Count and pickup are unchanged.
slopium.item_lod_distance.tooltip: Full-model radius in blocks, capped by chunk distance.
slopium.item_range.tooltip: Hide dropped items beyond the radius. Pickup and simulation remain.
slopium.item_render_distance.tooltip: Distance to item bounds in blocks. 0 hides items away from the camera.
slopium.be_range.tooltip: Hide distant special block models. Static geometry, Flywheel and Sable remain.
slopium.be_render_distance.tooltip: Distance to model bounds in blocks. May hide machine contents and indicators.
slopium.pause_xaero_benchmark.tooltip: Skip Xaero GPU timing waits. Map uploads continue; refresh may slow.
slopium.disable_shadows.tooltip: Remove vanilla entity ground shadows. Shader-pack shadows are unchanged.
slopium.flywheel_distance: Update distant Flywheel animations less often
slopium.flywheel_distance.tooltip: Throttle selected visuals beyond the radius. Combines with the other interval using the larger value.
slopium.flywheel_distance_radius.tooltip: Full-rate radius from camera in blocks, plus a 4-block margin.
slopium.flywheel_interval.tooltip: Update selected distant visuals once every N frames.
slopium.item_impostors: Replace distant items with flat sprites
slopium.item_impostors.tooltip: Flat sprites for distant items. Excludes named, enchanted and custom models.
slopium.item_impostor_distance.tooltip: Full-model item radius in blocks. Beyond it, use flat sprites.
slopium.create_visuals.tooltip: Throttle animations from Processed blocks beyond the radius. Motion becomes stepped; server unchanged.
slopium.create_visual_distance.tooltip: Smooth-animation radius from camera in blocks, plus a 4-block margin.
slopium.create_visual_interval.tooltip: Update selected distant animations once every N frames.
slopium.particle_budget.tooltip: Cap new standard particles per client tick. Excess effects, including useful ones, are discarded.
slopium.particles_per_tick.tooltip: Total new particles per tick. 0 blocks new particles.
slopium.texture_interpolation.tooltip: Stop blending animated texture frames, including icons. Animation becomes stepped.
slopium.factory_connections.tooltip: Hide distant lines on selected panels. Preserve nearby endpoints and the targeted panel.
slopium.factory_bulbs.tooltip: Hide distant indicators on selected panels. Panel state keeps updating.
slopium.particle_light_cache.tooltip: Reuse particle light within one block and tick. Lighting may lag by one tick.
slopium.particle_range.tooltip: Hide distant standard particles. Motion and lifetime remain.
slopium.distance_create_ticks.tooltip: Throttle selected distant blocks’ client ticks. Effects may slow; server unchanged.
slopium.create_tick_interval: Beyond radius: one tick out of N
slopium.create_tick_interval.tooltip: One distant client tick in N. Skipped time is not replayed.
slopium.factory_connection_distance.tool: Line radius in blocks plus 2 blocks. Preserve nearby endpoints.
slopium.factory_bulb_distance.tooltip: Indicator radius for selected panels, in blocks.
slopium.particle_render_distance.tooltip: Radius to particle bounds in blocks, capped by chunk distance.
slopium.create_tick_distance.tooltip: Full-rate tick radius plus 4 blocks. Nearby and targeted machines are protected.
slopium.occlude_particles.tooltip: Hide particles behind selected obstacles. Simulation continues; visibility updates with a delay.
slopium.occlude_create_rendering.tooltip: Hide selected special models behind obstacles. Flywheel is separate. GPU section culling leaves these models visible.
slopium.occlude_flywheel.tooltip: Hide selected blocks’ Flywheel instances behind obstacles. Model parts follow their owner block.
slopium.occlude_create_animations.toolti: Pause selected visuals’ animations behind obstacles. Models remain; server keeps running.
slopium.occlude_create_ticks.tooltip: Throttle client ticks behind obstacles after the grace period. Effects may slow; server keeps running.
slopium.hide_factory_connections.tooltip: Hide all lines on selected panels. Server connections remain.
slopium.factory_items.tooltip: Hide selected panel items beyond the radius. Filters and server logistics remain.
slopium.factory_item_distance.tooltip: Item radius for selected panels, in blocks.
slopium.particle_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: solid obstacles. Any: also glass, plants and fluids by block shape; holes remain open.
slopium.create_render_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: solid obstacles. Any: also glass, plants and fluids by block shape; holes remain open.
slopium.flywheel_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: solid obstacles. Any: also glass, plants and fluids by block shape; holes remain open.
slopium.animation_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: solid obstacles. Any: also glass, plants and fluids by block shape; holes remain open.
slopium.tick_occluders.tooltip: Opaque: solid obstacles. Any: also glass, plants and fluids by block shape; holes remain open.
slopium.group.test_warning: Full overrides take priority over normal settings
slopium.particle_visibility.tooltip: Hide behind opaque blocks, any block shapes, or always. Centre checks may hide visible edges. Always also rejects new standard particles.
slopium.create_visibility.tooltip: Hide selected special models behind obstacles or always. Static geometry remains; Flywheel is separate. Centre checks may lag.
slopium.flywheel_visibility.tooltip: Hide selected blocks’ Flywheel instances behind obstacles or always. Parts follow their owner; static geometry remains. Sable is protected.
slopium.animation_visibility.tooltip: Pause selected blocks’ Flywheel animations and rotation behind obstacles or always. Models remain. Server runs; visibility updates with a delay.
slopium.create_tick_mode.tooltip: Throttle or freeze selected blocks’ client ticks. Effects and interactions may slow; server keeps running. Turn off to restore.
slopium.factory_connection_mode.tooltip: All lines, nearby lines, or hide selected panels’ lines. Server connections remain.
slopium.block_models.tooltip: Show all special models, nearby only, or hide. Global across mods; the Create filter does not restrict it. Static geometry and Flywheel are separate.
slopium.hint.block_radius: Available only with Special block models → Within radius.
slopium.camera_culling.tooltip: Skip particles and selected models outside the camera. Combines with obstacle checks through shared visibility storage.
slopium.gpu_glass_culling.tooltip: Test sections on the GPU before drawing. Required for section culling. When off, Sodium renders normally. May add cost in some scenes.
slopium.frame_generation_mark.tooltip: Pink stripe on generated frames. Sequential output only.
slopium.frame_generation_multiplier.tool: Maximum multiplier: ×2 adds up to 1 frame, ×32 up to 31. Actual output depends on GPU, VSync and caps.
slopium.frame_generation_grid.tooltip: Simple reprojection step in pixels. Smaller gives finer edges at higher cost. Sequential mode only.
slopium.frame_generation_counter.tooltip: Same FPS as F3: world renders / window presentations, including repeats. About a one-second sample; HUD updates with real frames.
slopium.frame_generation.conflict: Disabled: remove standalone FrameGen/PFG from mods and restart Minecraft.
slopium.frame_generation_input.tooltip: With amortization: total output target (0 = 60). Otherwise: real-FPS target (0 = auto/uncapped). Target is not guaranteed.
slopium.frame_generation_fast.tooltip: Skip repeated world preparation. Input, ticks and HUD continue. Sequential only; disable for mod rendering issues.
slopium.frame_generation_parallel.toolti: Generate and present on a separate Windows thread. Hand/HUD update with real frames. Needs GPU/VRAM; pauses in menus and without focus.
slopium.frame_generation_amortize.toolti: Fill to target FPS; stop synthesis above it. Ignores multiplier and does not cap real FPS. Needs GPU headroom.
slopium.number.hint: Right-click or Shift + left-click to enter an exact number (Sodium and Reese).
slopium.frame_generation_refinement.tool: Motion refinement: 0 = whole pixels; 1–4 = 1/2–1/16 pixel. Finer motion at higher GPU cost.
slopium.frame_generation_protect.tooltip: Preserve motion boundaries and reject uncertain warps. Less smearing, possible local jumps.
slopium.processed_blocks.tooltip: Shared filter for Create/Flywheel models, animations, panel details and client ticks. Select block IDs; model parts follow their owner block.
slopium.frame_generation_low_latency.too: Do not wait for interpolation. Slopium predicts motion between real frames; sudden motion changes may jump. Turn off for native FSR interpolation. GPU work and VSync can still delay output.
slopium.frame_generation.predict_title: Slopium: motion prediction · real frames first
slopium.visible_sections.tooltip: GPU culls hidden 16³ sections beyond the protected radius. Requires GPU culling. Chunk data and ticks remain unchanged.
slopium.minimum_sections.tooltip: Normal Sodium behaviour within this X/Y/Z radius. 0 protects the camera section. Must be below view distance.
slopium.section_obstacles.tooltip: Opaque: solid and cutout surfaces with alpha discard. Any: also glass and fluid surfaces. Geometric openings remain open.
